level_reasons: Break My Fix finding 1: an input that breaks unyt.array.unyt_array.to_astropy

issue.title: unyt fails to convert dimensionless array to astropy using .to_astropy()

summary.text: The original dimensionless to_astropy() failure was reproduced and no regressions were found. However, Break My Fix found that unyt_quantity(5.0, 'km/m').to_astropy() returns <Quantity 5.>, which appears to drop the km/m scale factor, so check how the fix handles dimensionless units that carry a non-unit scale, and note that no guarding test was confirmed.

property.name: dimensionless_preserves_scaled_value
property.claim: For dimensionless units, including scaled ones like cm/m, the astropy quantity must have the same pure-number value once its units are cancelled out.
property.quote: Creates a new AstroPy quantity with the same unit information.

findings.relation: new with the fix: before it, this input returns <Quantity 5. km / m>
